steps_title: How the AI breakdown diagnosis works
steps_subtitle: Three steps, a few minutes, no account to create.
step1_desc: What the engine does, when, under which conditions. Add the engine type, brand and hours if you like.
step2_desc: The assistant only asks what separates the causes: starting, idle, temperature, smoke, noise…
step3_desc: A summary of the likely failure, 2 to 3 causes from the cheapest to the most expensive to check, and one concrete next step.
symptoms_title: The engine failures the assistant can
symptoms_subtitle: The diagnosis relies on our workshop checklists: 2-stroke outboards, inboard diesels (shaft line, saildrive), sterndrives and generators. Click a symptom to describe your breakdown.
symptom1_desc: Starter cranks with no start, flooded engine or no spark: fuel, ignition or compression, checked in that order.
symptom2_title: It stalls at idle or lacks power
symptom2_desc: Rough idle, hesitation under throttle, capped RPM: filter, carburetor or injection, fuel supply, reed valves.
symptom3_title: It overheats or the temperature alarm sounds
symptom3_desc: No tell-tale stream, worn impeller, clogged heat exchanger or thermostat: the raw-water cooling circuit first.
symptom4_desc: The smoke colour tells the story: water or cooling, burning oil, or excess fuel and injection.
symptom5_title: It won't shift or the lower unit is noisy
symptom5_desc: Control cable, gearbox, milky gear oil or worn gears: what to check before taking anything apart.
symptom6_title: The starter clicks or nothing lights up
symptom6_desc: Battery, terminals, kill switch, starter relay: the cheapest electrical checks come first.
symptom7_title: The inboard diesel hunts or dies
symptom7_desc: Air leak, primary water separator, contaminated diesel, lift pump: the fuel circuit step by step.
symptom8_desc: Temperature safety, oil level, water intake, excessive load: why a genset stops.
faq_q1: Is the AI breakdown diagnosis really free and account-free?
faq_a1: Yes. You get {count} free diagnoses without creating an account, straight from this page. No credit card, no sign-up.
faq_a2: 2-stroke outboards, inboard diesels (shaft line and saildrive), sterndrives and generators. The assistant relies on the same workshop checklists as the FleetAi app and only recommends checks that apply to your engine family.
faq_a3: No. The assistant helps you narrow the diagnosis down and check the cheapest things first. It replaces neither your engine's service manual nor a professional, and it is not a guaranteed technical diagnosis.
faq_q4: What happens after my {count} free diagnoses?
faq_a4: Create your free FleetAi account (Starter plan): you get the full troubleshooting checklists, the maintenance log and reminders. Pro and Enterprise plans add the AI assistant with no conversation cap.
faq_a5: The conversation is kept so you can pick it up again during your visit. As long as you have no account it is tied to no identity: only your browser can return to it.
faq_a6: A Mistral AI model, guided by our diagnostic checklists. It never quotes a figure specific to an engine model: for a torque value or a pressure, it points you to the service manual.
